_about: Code-map writer (home page, src/code/**). Only terms that belong to the code map and to LLMEngine. General terms are in core.json, basics.json and the other files.

llm-engine.short: The Python class that owns the scheduler, the KV block managers and the driver worker. LLM calls its step() again and again until all requests finish.
llm-engine.long: Defined in {{cite deepinfer/engine/llm_engine.py:130}}. One engine runs in each data-parallel process.

driver-worker.short: The Worker object that runs in the same process as LLMEngine. It does the model work for its rank and sends each method call to the other context-parallel ranks.
driver-worker.long: Made in {{cite deepinfer/engine/llm_engine.py:402-413}} with is_driver_worker=True. Follower workers run in their own processes and wait in a loop for calls ({{cite deepinfer/worker/base.py:129-133}}).

engine-callbacks.short: Two engine functions that the driver worker calls during a step: pre_sampler_sync after sampling starts, and post_process when a step's results are ready.
engine-callbacks.long: The engine passes them in an EngineCallbacks object ({{cite deepinfer/engine/llm_engine.py:398-400}}, {{cite deepinfer/worker/worker.py:43-48}}).

request-output-pool.short: A C++ pool of RequestOutput objects. step() returns uint64 handles into this pool. The engine gives the objects back to the pool one step later.
request-output-pool.long: Python code reads a handle with RequestOutput.clone(ptr) ({{cite deepinfer/_C/engine.pyi:180-183}}). LLM clones every output before the next step ({{cite deepinfer/entrypoints/llm.py:179-182}}).

git-submodule.short: A folder in a git repository that points to a commit of another repository. A plain clone leaves the folder empty until you run git submodule update.
git-submodule.long: DeepInfer has six submodules in vendor/ ({{cite .gitmodules}}). scripts/build_vendor.sh fetches them ({{cite scripts/build_vendor.sh:27-28}}).
